scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the next six Expo originals. No executions or permanent exclusions.
linked_reference_caveat: Only these six complete originals were read. Linked references, actual projects, installed SDK types, generated artifacts, example sources and licenses still need separate review. No installation, build, deployment, account action or source command occurred.

sources.workflow: Add the actual iOS Clip target, matching parent and Clip identity and entitlements, hosted association and banner, native permissions and metadata, then build and submit the real paired app when shipping is requested.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real compatible Expo app, Apple target tooling, exact bundle and team identities, native build tools and reviewed generated target contract are needed. Shipping additionally needs authorized store membership, signing, a real HTTPS association host, actual store metadata and acceptance. Associated reference and tool implementations and source claims need separate review rather than copying the example's identities.
sources.offline_assessment: A narrowly selected target-config or association-file change could be offline using a real public app and reviewed schema. The default Python container cannot build, host, sign or submit iOS apps. Draft AASA JSON cannot prove a live association or actual Clip launch.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the exact parent and Clip target, team identity, generated entitlements, required permissions and metadata with actual build outputs and the requested invocation. Separate local file checks from hosted association, embedded Clip archive, store processing and observed device launch. Preserve existing identity and avoid treating the example's identifiers as actual accounts.

sources.workflow: Inspect the actual native host, select isolated binary-library or integrated-source adoption, embed the requested React Native feature while preserving native ownership, and verify feature input, result, dismissal, reopening and release-host behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual native application, lockfile and deployment targets, compatible producer dependencies and native build tools are required. The producer needs Node and its package manager. Native consumers have different tool requirements from React Native producers. Approach, version-compatibility and feature-lifecycle references require review; native-only EAS distribution is a different task.
sources.offline_assessment: Code-only integration can be offline with real public host and producer sources and a reviewed compatible toolchain. The default Python runtime cannot build native artifacts or run the host app. A working producer example or Expo Go screen does not validate the actual consuming native app.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check host shell and navigation preservation, exact native artifact or source linkage, version constraints and listener lifecycle. Require actual input-result-dismiss-reopen behavior and a release host with release artifact and development server stopped for the full integration claim. Do not run regeneration over a manually maintained host.

sources.workflow: Adopt and extend the actual existing theme or styling library, centralize repeated visual values and appropriate reusable component contracts, then inspect rendered hierarchy, consistency and interaction instead of creating a competing speculative design system.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual app screens, current theme and styling dependencies and compatible React Native interfaces are required. Audit, named anti-pattern and platform references define task-specific checks and need separate review. Actual rendering and accessibility or interaction inspection need a compatible app runtime; no live account or external service is inherently required.
sources.offline_assessment: Theme extraction, drift analysis and source-level component changes can be offline using unchanged public app code and actual local types and tests. The default standard-library container cannot render native screens. A grep count or a token file alone does not establish improved layout, working controls or accessibility.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the requested change with existing system authority, all affected imports, static-safe versus hook-only colors, text scaling and explicit variant/state/accessibility behavior. Validate rendered modes and primary-task interactions, with screen evidence where appropriate. Preserve caller layout overrides without confusing a static source check with visual or behavioral acceptance.

sources.workflow: Configure the actual development-client profile, build locally or through the selected cloud path, install the resulting app on the intended device or simulator, and connect it to the correct development server for native-feature testing.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real compatible app with the selected native dependencies and build profile, appropriate local native toolchain or authorized cloud build, actual install target and development server are required. Signing and distribution depend on platform and chosen path. Local compilation does not universally require a hosted account, while TestFlight distribution adds its own membership and processing requirements.
sources.offline_assessment: Configuration editing or fully provisioned local builds may be offline in a reviewed native toolchain. The default Python container cannot compile, install or launch the native app. A saved profile or produced archive is not an installed functioning development client, and a cloud submission is not verified tester access.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Bind exact app and profile, native artifact type and build identity to the actual installed client and intended development server. Test the requested native feature and actual reload behavior rather than merely observing launcher UI or a build-list entry. Treat device installation, server connection, distribution and production release as separate outcomes.

sources.workflow: Integrate a focused actual web component through a separate DOM component file, preserve native navigation and bridge only supported serialized props and asynchronous actions, then validate web and native-webview behavior for the selected feature.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual app and web component, compatible Expo DOM and webview runtime, required web libraries and correct installed bridge and router types are needed. Native state hooks that require synchronous access must stay in the native parent. The source's broad serializable-prop rule and explicit asynchronous action exception must be reconciled with actual installed APIs rather than interpreted as ordinary cross-context shared state.
sources.offline_assessment: A source-only conversion or local web-component test may be offline in a reviewed JavaScript runtime. The default Python container cannot render a native webview or prove cross-context native action delivery. Web-only rendering is not native-platform validation, and DOM isolation does not supply direct shared JavaScript state.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual directive placement, separate default export, DOM prop types, CSS and asset bundling, allowed bridge values and router-state handoff. Test selected actions and rendering on declared platforms against the real input component. Keep code generation, browser behavior and native webview integration separate, and profile rather than assume native-equivalent performance.

sources.workflow: Select the actual current first-party integration example, inspect its complete relevant tree and high-signal setup and code, then adapt only its needed pattern into an existing app or scaffold a separate new project when that mode is requested.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual app or scaffold request, selected example's real source tree and metadata, compatible SDK and dependency and config contracts are required. Live example discovery requires current repository access, while a pinned offline adaptation must disclose snapshot age. Example secret values are placeholders. Catalog and integration source licenses and referenced setup need separate review.
sources.offline_assessment: A labeled adaptation from an unchanged public pinned example can be offline with reviewed app inputs and local toolchain. That cannot establish a current live example catalog, and the default Python container cannot run arbitrary mobile integrations. An integration involving a service has additional task-specific requirements that a generic example does not satisfy.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the actual example and alias/deprecation metadata with its selected pattern and compatible app version. Check non-destructive dependency and configuration merging, all required integration files and environment shapes, and concrete requested behavior using an independent local or native acceptance check. A visually plausible wiring change is not a functioning service integration.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
